context:
Introduce a core runtime-path resolver module that encapsulates precedence
and normalization rules (explicit override > environment > default). Keep MCP
argument parsing in MCP-specific CLI code, then pass resolved paths into MCP
server/tool registration (dependency injection) instead of module-level
constants.

Update CLI internals to consume the same core resolver for default benchmark
runs roots/results paths while preserving CLI command surface.

Validate with targeted MCP + CLI regression tests and docs synchronization.
description:
MCP benchmark execution currently ignores runtime configuration for result
directories. `benchbox-mcp --results-dir <path>` is not parsed, and MCP
read/write tools default to hard-coded `benchmark_runs/results` paths.

This creates a behavioral regression against expected MCP configurability and
contradicts docs that describe `BENCHBOX_RESULTS_DIR` support.

Constraints from review:
- MCP and CLI remain separate interfaces (no CLI flag coupling).
- Path-resolution logic must be centralized in core and reused by both MCP
  internals and CLI internals.
- MCP write path (benchmark export) and MCP read paths (results/analytics/
  visualization/resources) must use the same resolved directory.

anti_patterns.dont: duplicate env/path precedence logic across modules

anti_patterns.dont: keep module-level hard-coded DEFAULT_RESULTS_DIR in MCP tools
anti_patterns.instead: inject resolved roots at registration time.
anti_patterns.why: write/read paths must stay in sync
